def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    mask = bins >= item
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    if np.any(mask):
        k = np.floor_divide(bins[mask], item)
        rem = bins[mask] % item
        priorities[mask] = k / (1 + rem)
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    max_items = np.floor_divide(bins, item)
    remaining_space = bins - max_items * item
    return np.where(bins >= item, remaining_space, -np.inf)

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    mask = bins >= item
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    remaining = bins[mask] - item
    priorities[mask] = -np.abs(remaining - 0.5 * bins[mask])
    return priorities
